title: On the Study of Words
author: Richard Chenevix Trench
description: "On the Study of Words" by Richard Chenevix Trench is a scholarly work that delves into the complexities of language and etymology, likely written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: This treatise explores how words embody and convey moral, historical, and emotional truths and urges readers to appreciate the profound significance tied to language.

authorInfo.bio: Richard Chenevix Trench (1807–1886) wrote On the Study of Words. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
